question: Which of the following devices can perform both input and output functions?
solution:
**The correct option is (1)**

Communication device

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Communication devices can perform both input and output functions.
 
• Every piece of hardware that can send and receive data, instructions and information is referred to as a communications device.
 
• A modem is a communication tool that joins a channel to a sending or receiving device, like a computer.
 
• The term "communication device" refers to any system or device that may record or send data or other communications, including the Internet, computers, scanners, phones, mobile phones, tablets, and wireless communications devices.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/185f61c10be7bf598fff090b7dee5874a5c95a149b3043b5738b662981e66725.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**** Keyboard:- **The most straightforward method for a user to interact with a computer is through the use of a keyboard, which is an input device.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cde6762d9c1c6254f03087f8d8db508e941eba28df4fa75c8d489b9187dc7e2a.png] 

**Mouse:-** A computer mouse is a portable hardware input tool for pointing, moving, and selecting text, icons, files, and folders on a computer's graphical user interface (GUI).

 [IMAGE: https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcTM_ZR9QNfxRnJkLNSFJmyPmLVqryKFUYJbyw&usqp=CAU] 

**Trackball:-** Many laptop keyboards and earlier models of computer mice use trackballs as the cursor control mechanism.
